title: Double Shoulder Strap for Trimmer & Brush Cutter – Heavy-Duty Nylon Harness
descriptionHtml:
Heavy brush cutter weighing you down?

A simple strap puts all the weight on one shoulder and cuts into your neck. After a while of clearing, your back and shoulders ache – and your precision fades as you get tired.

Spread the weight – work longer

The double shoulder harness spreads the load evenly across both shoulders and your back. Heavy-duty, adjustable nylon straps give a stable grip so you can clear the whole yard without aching.

Features

  • Double shoulder straps – even weight distribution, less strain.
  • Heavy-duty nylon – handles heavy brush cutters and hard use.
  • Fully adjustable – fits all body sizes.
  • Quick-connect – easy to put on and take off.

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
